parameters.content:
## v4.0.3 — No ticket-field mapping
1. Select Sheets credential, Document and Sheet. Set Auto-Map LAST. Keep Day 1 headers.
2. Select Slack credential + support channel FROM LIST.
3. Save AND Publish this helper.
4. In the NEW 03 agent create_ticket choose this helper. That is all: NO four-field mappings or sparkle buttons.

The trigger uses Accept all data. Validate ticket input parses the supplied JSON and checks all four required fields BEFORE any write. TEST HELPER supplies an explicit fictional sample.

Main flow: Validate → Sheet save → Slack alert → Confirm. No refund/customer email is sent. Only Slack retries its own step; a full new request can create another ticket.

parameters.jsCode: const x=$json;const esc=v=>String(v??'').replace(/&/g,'&').replace(/</g,'<').replace(/>/g,'>');if(x.ticket_saved!==true||!/^KAAPI-\d+$/.test(x.ticket_id||''))throw new Error('No confirmed saved ticket; Slack was not called.');const lines=['🎫 *'+esc(x.ticket_id)+' — '+esc(x.priority.toUpperCase())+' PRIORITY*','*Status:* Open — human review','*Category:* '+esc(x.category),'*Order:* '+esc(x.order_id||'Not supplied'),'*Summary:* '+esc(x.summary),'*Action:* Human review required. No refund has been approved or issued.','','*Draft reply — NOT sent to customer:*',esc(x.draft_reply)];return [{json:{...x,slack_text:lines.join('\n')}}];

const saved=$('Prepare Slack notification').first().json;const r=$json;const ts=r.message_timestamp||r.ts||r.message?.ts;if(r.error||r.ok===false||!ts||!r.channel)return [{json:{...saved,ok:false,slack_notified:false,error:'slack_notification_unconfirmed',slack_text:undefined,slack_error:typeof r.error==='string'?r.error:(r.error?.message||r.message||'See Slack output'),message:'Ticket saved; Slack notification could not be confirmed. The ticket row remains saved. Fix the Slack credential/channel; do not rerun the agent just to retry notification.',output:'Ticket '+saved.ticket_id+' saved in Sheets. Slack delivery unconfirmed.'}}];const {slack_text,...safe}=saved;return [{json:{...safe,ok:true,slack_notified:true,slack_channel:r.channel,slack_message_ts:ts,message:'Support ticket saved in Sheets and posted to Slack for human review. No refund or customer email sent.',output:'Ticket '+saved.ticket_id+' saved in Sheets and notified in Slack. Human review required.'}}];
